access.notes: Reference: FINKELNBURG W. and HUMBACH W., Naturwiss. 42, 35 (1955). Contains second ionization potentials I2 for the relevant elements.
Reference: WYCKOFF R. W. G., 'Crystal Structures', Interscience Publishers, New York. Provides lattice constants (a0) and structure types for the compounds.
Reference: PAULING L., 'The Nature of the Chemical Bond', Cornell Univ. Press (1940). Provides Born exponent n for each compound.

References: ROSSINI F. D. et al., Selected Values of Chemical Thermodynamic Properties, NBS Circular No. 500 (1952); LONG L. H., Quart. Rev. 7, 134 (1953). Contains heats of formation ΔHf, sublimation energies L, and atomization enthalpies D for halogens (except fluorine).
